head: "WALL STREET IS
*DUMPING BITCOIN*"
scenes.say: Wall Street is dumping Bitcoin. That's this week's loudest claim. Let's check.

head: $1.3 BILLION
*OUT OF BTC ETFs*
scenes.say: Spot Bitcoin E T Fs lost one point three billion last week. Most since June.

head: BUT $99 BILLION
~IS STILL INSIDE~
scenes.say: But ninety nine billion is still inside. Only about one percent left.

head: WHY SELL NOW?
*CPI TUESDAY*
scenes.sub: ~80% ODDS OF A DEC FED HIKE
scenes.say: Why now? Analysts point to Tuesday's inflation data and Fed hike fears.

head: TRUE –
*BUT SMALL*
scenes.note: SEND THIS TO A FRIEND WHO HOLDS BTC
scenes.say: Verdict: true, but small. Bull or bear by Friday? Not financial advice, just data.
